children: Skyworks Solutions’ fiscal 2026 revenue and earnings declined from the prior year. Revenue fell 3.1%, primarily on decreased market share at a significant customer, partly offset by stronger demand for automotive, data center and Wi-Fi products. Gross profit was pressured by higher input costs and unfavorable product mix, partly offset by higher unit volumes.
¹ Reported as “Net revenue”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted”.
: Net revenue decreased 3.1%, primarily due to lower market share at a significant customer; automotive, data center and Wi-Fi demand increased.
: Gross profit as a share of net revenue was 40.8%, compared with 41.2%; higher input costs and unfavorable mix were partly offset by higher unit volumes.
: Research and development expense rose 6.6% to $837.0M, primarily reflecting increased headcount-related costs as investment in new technologies and products grew.
: Restructuring, impairment and other charges were $124.2M, mainly for facility consolidation and closure and impairment charges.
